sing-box=7d24f54bdd11d36219e71f99b937201f0a4eef16
golang-x-mobile=v0.0.0-20260410095206-2cfb76559b7b
gomobile-flags=-tags "with_utls" -ldflags="-s -w"
platform=ios,iossimulator,macos
rebuilt-at=2026-04-24T19:22:00Z
rebuilt-reason=v0.2.3 xcframework had only iOS slices (no macOS) and used macOS-style versioned bundle layout inside iOS slices, which is incompatible with shallow iOS bundles in bare SwiftUI/SPM projects. Rebuild produces flat iOS layout + macOS slice.
rebuild-steps=|
  git clone --depth 50 https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box.git
  git fetch --depth 1 origin 7d24f54bdd11d36219e71f99b937201f0a4eef16
  git checkout 7d24f54bdd11d36219e71f99b937201f0a4eef16
  go install golang.org/x/mobile/cmd/gomobile golang.org/x/mobile/cmd/gobind
  go get golang.org/x/mobile/bind
  gomobile bind -target=ios,iossimulator,macos -tags "with_utls" -ldflags="-s -w" -o Libbox.xcframework ./experimental/libbox
